            "state": ["state", "province", "region"],
            "country": ["country", "nation"],
            "zip": ["zip", "postal", "postcode", "postal code"],
            "address": ["address", "street", "location"],
            
            # Professional fields
            "resume": ["resume", "cv", "curriculum vitae"],
            "cover_letter": ["cover letter", "coverletter"],
            "portfolio": ["portfolio", "website", "personal site"],
            "github": ["github", "gitlab", "code repository"],
            
            # Education
            "university": ["university", "college", "school", "education"],
            "degree": ["degree", "qualification"],
            "major": ["major", "field of study", "subject"],
            "graduation_year": ["graduation", "grad year", "year graduated"],
            
            # Work
            "company": ["company", "employer", "organization"],
            "title": ["title", "job title", "position", "role"],
            "experience": ["experience", "years of experience"],
            "salary": ["salary", "compensation", "pay", "expected salary"],
            
            # Other
            "referral": ["referral", "referred by", "how did you hear"],
            "authorization": ["authorized", "legally authorized", "work authorization"],
            "sponsorship": ["sponsorship", "visa sponsorship", "require sponsorship"],
            "relocate": ["relocate", "relocation", "willing to move"],
            "remote": ["remote", "work from home", "hybrid"],
            "start_date": ["start date", "available from", "when can you start"],
        }
        
        # Flatten profile
        flat_profile = self._flatten_profile(profile)
        
        # Match fields
        for field in fields:
            label = field.get("label", "").lower()
            field_type = field.get("type", "text")
            
            best_match = None
            best_confidence = 0.0
            
            # Try to find matching profile key
            for profile_key, keywords in field_rules.items():
                for keyword in keywords:
                    if keyword in label:
                        # Check if profile has this key
                        if profile_key in flat_profile:
                            confidence = 0.9 if keyword == label else 0.7
                            if confidence > best_confidence:
                                best_match = profile_key
                                best_confidence = confidence
                        break
            
            # Check for exact label match
            if not best_match:
                for key in flat_profile:
                    if key.lower() in label or label in key.lower():
                        best_match = key
                        best_confidence = 0.6
                        break
            
            if best_match:
                mappings.append(FieldMapping(
                    field_label=field.get("label", ""),
                    field_type=field_type,
                    field_selector=field.get("selector"),
                    field_id=field.get("id"),
                    field_name=field.get("name"),
                    profile_key=best_match,
                    profile_value=flat_profile[best_match],
                    confidence=best_confidence,
                ))
            elif field.get("required"):
                # Required field without match - log for attention
                logger.info(f"Required field without match: {label}")
                mappings.append(FieldMapping(
                    field_label=field.get("label", ""),
                    field_type=field_type,
                    field_selector=field.get("selector"),
                    field_id=field.get("id"),
                    field_name=field.get("name"),
                    profile_key="",
                    profile_value=None,
                    confidence=0.0,
                ))
        
        return mappings
    
    def _flatten_profile(self, profile: dict, prefix: str = "") -> dict:
        """Flatten nested profile dict."""
        result = {}
        for key, value in profile.items():
            full_key = f"{prefix}_{key}" if prefix else key
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                result.update(self._flatten_profile(value, full_key))
            else:
                result[full_key] = value
                result[key] = value  # Also add without prefix
        return result
    
    def _basic_mapping(self, profile: dict, fields: list[dict]) -> list[FieldMapping]:
        """Basic mapping without AI - use when AI fails."""
        return self._map_profile_to_fields(profile, fields)
    
    async def _fill_field(
        self,
        page: Any,
        mapping: FieldMapping,
        snapshot: FormSnapshot,
    ) -> bool:
        """Fill a single field."""
        if not mapping.profile_value:
            return False
        
        field_type = mapping.field_type.lower()
        value = str(mapping.profile_value)
        
        # Get selector
        selector = mapping.field_selector
        if not selector:
            if mapping.field_id:
                selector = f"#{mapping.field_id}"
            elif mapping.field_name:
                selector = f"[name='{mapping.field_name}']"
            else:
                # Use field finder for custom components
                return await self._fill_custom_field(page, mapping, snapshot)
        
        try:
            # Handle different field types
            if field_type in ("select", "dropdown"):
                return await self._fill_select(page, selector, value)
            elif field_type in ("checkbox", "radio"):
                return await self._fill_checkbox_radio(page, selector, value)
            elif field_type == "file":
                return await self._fill_file(page, selector, value)
            elif field_type in ("textarea",):
                return await self._fill_textarea(page, selector, value)
            else:
                # Standard text input
                return await self._fill_text(page, selector, value)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Standard fill failed for {mapping.field_label}: {e}")
            # Try custom fill
            return await self._fill_custom_field(page, mapping, snapshot)
    
    async def _fill_text(self, page: Any, selector: str, value: str) -> bool:
        """Fill text input."""
        await page.fill(selector, value)
        return True
    
    async def _fill_textarea(self, page: Any, selector: str, value: str) -> bool:
        """Fill textarea."""
        await page.fill(selector, value)
        return True
    
    async def _fill_select(self, page: Any, selector: str, value: str) -> bool:
        """Fill select dropdown."""
        try:
            await page.select_option(selector, label=value)
            return True
        except:
            # Try by value
            try:
                await page.select_option(selector, value=value)
                return True
            except:
                # Try partial match
                try:
                    await page.select_option(selector, label=value, partial_match=True)
                    return True
                except:
                    return False
    
    async def _fill_checkbox_radio(self, page: Any, selector: str, value: str) -> bool:
        """Fill checkbox or radio."""
        should_check = str(value).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes", "on")
        if should_check:
            await page.check(selector)
        else:
            await page.uncheck(selector)
        return True
    
    async def _fill_file(self, page: Any, selector: str, value: str) -> bool:
        """Fill file upload."""
        # value should be file path
        import os
        if os.path.exists(value):
            await page.set_input_files(selector, value)
            return True
        return False
    
    async def _fill_custom_field(
        self,
        page: Any,
        mapping: FieldMapping,
        snapshot: FormSnapshot,
    ) -> bool:
        """Fill a custom/non-standard field."""
        # This would use BlindFieldFinder for custom components
        # For now, try clicking the field and typing
        field_info = None
        for f in snapshot.fields:
            if f.get("label") == mapping.field_label:
                field_info = f
                break
        
        if not field_info:
            return False
        
        bbox = field_info.get("bbox")
        if not bbox:
            return False
        
        # Click on field
        cx = bbox["x"] + bbox["width"] // 2
        cy = bbox["y"] + bbox["height"] // 2
        await page.mouse.click(cx, cy)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        
        # Type value
        await page.keyboard.type(str(mapping.profile_value))
        return True
    
    async def _fill_unselected_dropdown(
        self,
        page: Any,
        label: str,
        profile: dict,
        mappings: list[FieldMapping],
    ) -> bool:
        """Fill an unselected dropdown detected by vision."""
        # Find the dropdown in mappings
        for mapping in mappings:
            if mapping.field_label.lower() == label.lower():
                if not mapping.filled:
                    # Try to fill it
                    snapshot = await self._extract_form_snapshot(page)
                    return await self._fill_field(page, mapping, snapshot)
        return False
    
    def _is_required_field(self, mapping: FieldMapping, snapshot: FormSnapshot) -> bool:
        """Check if a field is required."""
        for field in snapshot.fields:
            if field.get("label") == mapping.field_label:
                return field.get("required", False)
        return False
    
    async def _vision_verify(self, screenshot: bytes) -> dict:
        """Use vision to verify form state."""
        if not self._kimi_vision:
            return {}
        
        try:
            response = await self._kimi_vision.generate_with_image(
                self.VERIFY_PROMPT,
                screenshot,
            )
            # Parse JSON response
            # Clean response if it has markdown code blocks
            if "```" in response:
                response = response.split("```")[1]
                if response.startswith("json"):
                    response = response[4:]
            return json.loads(response.strip())
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Vision verification failed: {e}")
            return {}

            elif field_type in ("textarea",):

        except:
            # Try by value
            try:

        else:

        return True

    async def _check_text_content(self, page: Any) -> OutcomeResult:
        """Analyze page text content for success/failure signals."""
        try:
            # Get visible text content
            text_content = await page.evaluate("""
                () => {
                    // Get all visible text
                    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(
                        document.body,
                        NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,
                        null,
                        false
                    );
                    
                    let text = '';
                    let node;
                    while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
                        if (node.parentElement) {
                            const style = window.getComputedStyle(node.parentElement);
                            if (style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden') {
                                text += node.textContent + ' ';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return text.toLowerCase();
                }
            """)
            
            text_lower = text_content.lower()
            
            success_signals = []
            failure_signals = []
            loading_signals = []
            
            # Check for success signals
            for signal in self.SUCCESS_TEXT_SIGNALS:
                if signal.lower() in text_lower:
                    success_signals.append(f"text:{signal}")
            
            # Check for failure signals
            for signal in self.FAILURE_TEXT_SIGNALS:
                if signal.lower() in text_lower:
                    failure_signals.append(f"text:{signal}")
            
            # Check for loading signals
            for signal in self.LOADING_SIGNALS:
                if signal.lower() in text_lower:
                    loading_signals.append(f"text:{signal}")
            
            # Determine outcome based on signal counts
            if loading_signals and not success_signals and not failure_signals:
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.LOADING,
                    confidence=0.6,
                    message="Page appears to be loading/processing",
                    success_signals=loading_signals,
                )
            
            if success_signals and not failure_signals:
                confidence = min(0.95, 0.6 + len(success_signals) * 0.1)
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.SUCCESS,
                    confidence=confidence,
                    message=f"Found {len(success_signals)} success signal(s)",
                    success_signals=success_signals,
                )
            
            if failure_signals and not success_signals:
                confidence = min(0.9, 0.5 + len(failure_signals) * 0.1)
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.ERROR,
                    confidence=confidence,
                    message=f"Found {len(failure_signals)} error signal(s)",
                    failure_signals=failure_signals,
                    error_details=failure_signals,
                )
            
            if success_signals and failure_signals:
                # Mixed signals - need visual confirmation
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                    confidence=0.4,
                    message="Mixed signals detected",
                    success_signals=success_signals,
                    failure_signals=failure_signals,
                )
            
            return OutcomeResult(

                confidence=0.3,
                message="No clear signals detected in text content",

            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                confidence=0.0,
                message=f"Text analysis error: {str(e)}",
            )
    
    async def _check_visual(self, screenshot: bytes) -> OutcomeResult:
        """Use Kimi 2.5 Vision to analyze screenshot."""
        if not self._kimi_vision:
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                confidence=0.0,
                message="Vision client not available",
            )
        
        try:
            prompt = """Look at this screenshot after clicking "Submit" on a job application form.

Determine the outcome:
1. SUCCESS — confirmation page, "thank you" message, reference number, success icon
2. ERROR — validation error, red error messages, "required field" warnings, error icons
3. LOADING — spinner, "processing..." message, progress indicator
4. SAME_PAGE — nothing changed, still on the same form
5. REDIRECT — completely different page (not application related)

Return JSON only:
{
    "outcome": "SUCCESS|ERROR|LOADING|SAME_PAGE|REDIRECT",
    "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
    "message": "Brief description of what you see",
    "reference_id": "APP-12345 or null",
    "success_indicators": ["thank you message", "confirmation number"],
    "error_indicators": ["red border on email field", "required field message"]
}
"""
            
            response = await self._kimi_vision.generate_with_image(prompt, screenshot)
            
            # Parse JSON response
            import json
            result = json.loads(response)

                "ERROR": OutcomeType.ERROR,

                "SAME_PAGE": OutcomeType.SAME_PAGE,

    async def _check_dom_changes(
        self,
        page: Any,
        before_url: str,
        before_dom_hash: str,
    ) -> OutcomeResult:
        """Check if DOM changed significantly after submission."""
        try:
            current_url = page.url
            
            # URL changed significantly
            if before_url and current_url != before_url:
                # Check if it's a redirect to a different domain
                from urllib.parse import urlparse
                before_domain = urlparse(before_url).netloc
                current_domain = urlparse(current_url).netloc
                
                if before_domain != current_domain:
                    return OutcomeResult(
                        outcome=OutcomeType.REDIRECT,
                        confidence=0.7,
                        message=f"Redirected to different domain: {current_domain}",
                    )
                
                # Same domain, different URL
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.REDIRECT,
                    confidence=0.5,
                    message=f"URL changed within same domain",
                )
            
            # Check DOM structure change
            if before_dom_hash:
                current_dom_hash = await self._compute_dom_hash(page)
                if current_dom_hash != before_dom_hash:
                    return OutcomeResult(
                        outcome=OutcomeType.SAME_PAGE,
                        confidence=0.4,
                        message="DOM changed but URL same - form may have updated",
                    )
            
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.SAME_PAGE,
                confidence=0.3,
                message="No significant changes detected",
            )
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"DOM change detection error: {e}")
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                confidence=0.0,
                message=f"DOM check error: {str(e)}",
            )
    
    async def _compute_dom_hash(self, page: Any) -> str:
        """Compute a hash of the current DOM structure."""
        import hashlib
        
        try:
            dom_structure = await page.evaluate("""
                () => {
                    // Get structural info only (not values)
                    const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea');
                    const forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
                    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button');
                    
                    return JSON.stringify({
                        input_count: inputs.length,
                        input_types: [...new Set([...inputs].map(i => i.type || i.tagName.toLowerCase()))],
                        form_count: forms.length,
                        button_count: buttons.length,
                        button_texts: [...buttons].map(b => b.textContent?.trim().slice(0, 30)).filter(t => t),
                    });
                }
            """)
            
            return hashlib.sha256(dom_structure.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
            
        except Exception:
            return ""

    async def wait_for_outcome(
        self,
        page: Any,
        max_wait_seconds: int = 30,
        poll_interval: float = 2.0,
    ) -> OutcomeResult:
        """
        Wait for a definitive outcome (not LOADING or UNKNOWN).
        
        Polls until a confident outcome is detected or timeout.
        """
        start_time = asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
        
        while True:
            result = await self.detect(page)
            
            if result.outcome not in (OutcomeType.LOADING, OutcomeType.UNKNOWN):
                return result
            
            elapsed = asyncio.get_event_loop().time() - start_time
            if elapsed >= max_wait_seconds:
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.TIMEOUT,
                    confidence=0.5,
                    message=f"Timed out after {max_wait_seconds}s waiting for outcome",
                )
            
            await asyncio.sleep(poll_interval)

                    outcome=OutcomeType.SUCCESS,
                    confidence=confidence,
                    message=f"Found {len(success_signals)} success signal(s)",
                    success_signals=success_signals,
                )
            
            if failure_signals and not success_signals:
                confidence = min(0.9, 0.5 + len(failure_signals) * 0.1)
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.ERROR,
                    confidence=confidence,
                    message=f"Found {len(failure_signals)} error signal(s)",
                    failure_signals=failure_signals,
                    error_details=failure_signals,
                )
            
            if success_signals and failure_signals:
                # Mixed signals - need visual confirmation
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                    confidence=0.4,
                    message="Mixed signals detected",
                    success_signals=success_signals,
                    failure_signals=failure_signals,
                )
            
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                confidence=0.3,
                message="No clear signals detected in text content",
            )
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Text content analysis error: {e}")
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                confidence=0.0,
                message=f"Text analysis error: {str(e)}",
            )
    
    async def _check_visual(self, screenshot: bytes) -> OutcomeResult:
        """Use Kimi 2.5 Vision to analyze screenshot."""
        if not self._kimi_vision:
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                confidence=0.0,
                message="Vision client not available",
            )
        
        try:
            prompt = """Look at this screenshot after clicking "Submit" on a job application form.

Determine the outcome:
1. SUCCESS — confirmation page, "thank you" message, reference number, success icon
2. ERROR — validation error, red error messages, "required field" warnings, error icons
3. LOADING — spinner, "processing..." message, progress indicator
4. SAME_PAGE — nothing changed, still on the same form
5. REDIRECT — completely different page (not application related)

Return JSON only:
{
    "outcome": "SUCCESS|ERROR|LOADING|SAME_PAGE|REDIRECT",
    "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
    "message": "Brief description of what you see",
    "reference_id": "APP-12345 or null",
    "success_indicators": ["thank you message", "confirmation number"],
    "error_indicators": ["red border on email field", "required field message"]
}
"""
            
            response = await self._kimi_vision.generate_with_image(prompt, screenshot)
            
            # Parse JSON response
            import json
            result = json.loads(response)
            
            outcome_map = {
                "SUCCESS": OutcomeType.SUCCESS,
                "ERROR": OutcomeType.ERROR,
                "LOADING": OutcomeType.LOADING,
                "SAME_PAGE": OutcomeType.SAME_PAGE,
                "REDIRECT": OutcomeType.REDIRECT,
            }
            
            outcome = outcome_map.get(result.get("outcome", "UNKNOWN"), OutcomeType.UNKNOWN)
            
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=outcome,
                confidence=result.get("confidence", 0.5),
                message=result.get("message", ""),
                reference_id=result.get("reference_id"),
                success_signals=result.get("success_indicators", []),
                failure_signals=result.get("error_indicators", []),
            )
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Visual analysis error: {e}")

    async def _check_dom_changes(
        self,
        page: Any,
        before_url: str,
        before_dom_hash: str,
    ) -> OutcomeResult:
        """Check if DOM changed significantly after submission."""
        try:
            current_url = page.url
            
            # URL changed significantly
            if before_url and current_url != before_url:
                # Check if it's a redirect to a different domain
                from urllib.parse import urlparse
                before_domain = urlparse(before_url).netloc
                current_domain = urlparse(current_url).netloc
                
                if before_domain != current_domain:
                    return OutcomeResult(
                        outcome=OutcomeType.REDIRECT,
                        confidence=0.7,
                        message=f"Redirected to different domain: {current_domain}",
                    )
                
                # Same domain, different URL
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.REDIRECT,
                    confidence=0.5,
                    message=f"URL changed within same domain",
                )
            
            # Check DOM structure change
            if before_dom_hash:
                current_dom_hash = await self._compute_dom_hash(page)
                if current_dom_hash != before_dom_hash:
                    return OutcomeResult(
                        outcome=OutcomeType.SAME_PAGE,
                        confidence=0.4,
                        message="DOM changed but URL same - form may have updated",
                    )
            
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.SAME_PAGE,
                confidence=0.3,
                message="No significant changes detected",
            )
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"DOM change detection error: {e}")
            return OutcomeResult(
                outcome=OutcomeType.UNKNOWN,
                confidence=0.0,
                message=f"DOM check error: {str(e)}",
            )
    
    async def _compute_dom_hash(self, page: Any) -> str:
        """Compute a hash of the current DOM structure."""
        import hashlib
        
        try:
            dom_structure = await page.evaluate("""
                () => {
                    // Get structural info only (not values)
                    const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea');
                    const forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
                    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button');
                    
                    return JSON.stringify({
                        input_count: inputs.length,
                        input_types: [...new Set([...inputs].map(i => i.type || i.tagName.toLowerCase()))],
                        form_count: forms.length,
                        button_count: buttons.length,
                        button_texts: [...buttons].map(b => b.textContent?.trim().slice(0, 30)).filter(t => t),
                    });
                }
            """)
            
            return hashlib.sha256(dom_structure.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
            
        except Exception:
            return ""

    async def wait_for_outcome(
        self,
        page: Any,
        max_wait_seconds: int = 30,
        poll_interval: float = 2.0,
    ) -> OutcomeResult:
        """
        Wait for a definitive outcome (not LOADING or UNKNOWN).
        
        Polls until a confident outcome is detected or timeout.
        """
        start_time = asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
        
        while True:
            result = await self.detect(page)
            
            if result.outcome not in (OutcomeType.LOADING, OutcomeType.UNKNOWN):
                return result
            
            elapsed = asyncio.get_event_loop().time() - start_time
            if elapsed >= max_wait_seconds:
                return OutcomeResult(
                    outcome=OutcomeType.TIMEOUT,
                    confidence=0.5,
                    message=f"Timed out after {max_wait_seconds}s waiting for outcome",
                )
            
            await asyncio.sleep(poll_interval)
    
    def get_outcome_summary(self, result: OutcomeResult) -> str:
        """Get a human-readable summary of the outcome."""
        if result.outcome == OutcomeType.SUCCESS:
            msg = f"✅ Application submitted successfully"
            if result.reference_id:
                msg += f" (Reference: {result.reference_id})"
            if result.success_signals:
                msg += f"\n   Signals: {', '.join(result.success_signals[:3])}"
            return msg
        
        elif result.outcome == OutcomeType.ERROR:
            msg = f"❌ Application failed"
            if result.error_details:
                msg += f": {', '.join(result.error_details[:3])}"
            return msg
        
        elif result.outcome == OutcomeType.LOADING:
            return "⏳ Application is processing..."
        
        elif result.outcome == OutcomeType.CAPTCHA:
            return "🛑 CAPTCHA detected - requires human intervention"
        
        elif result.outcome == OutcomeType.ACCOUNT_REQUIRED:
            return "🔐 Account/login required - cannot proceed automatically"
        
        elif result.outcome == OutcomeType.TIMEOUT:
            return f"⏱️ Timed out waiting for result: {result.message}"
        
        else:
            return f"❓ Unknown outcome (confidence: {result.confidence:.0%}): {result.message}"",

    """

    def __init__(self, data_dir: Optional[Path] = None):
        """Initialize pattern store."""
        if data_dir:
            self.DATA_DIR = data_dir
            self.PATTERNS_FILE = data_dir / "blind_site_patterns.json"
            self.WORKFLOWS_DIR = data_dir / "blind_site_workflows"
            self.STATS_FILE = data_dir / "blind_site_stats.json"
        
        self._patterns: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self._workflows: dict[str, SiteWorkflow] = {}
        self._stats: dict[str, DomainStats] = {}
        self._pending_workflows: dict[str, SiteWorkflow] = {}
        
        self._load_all()
    
    def _load_all(self):
        """Load all data from disk."""
        self._load_patterns()
        self._load_stats()
        self._load_workflows()
    
    def _load_patterns(self):
        """Load site patterns from JSON file."""
        if self.PATTERNS_FILE.exists():
            try:
                with open(self.PATTERNS_FILE, 'r') as f:
                    self._patterns = json.load(f)
                logger.info(f"Loaded patterns for {len(self._patterns)} domains")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to load patterns: {e}")
                self._patterns = {}
        else:
            self._patterns = {}
    
    def _load_stats(self):
        """Load domain statistics."""
        if self.STATS_FILE.exists():
            try:
                with open(self.STATS_FILE, 'r') as f:
                    data = json.load(f)
                    self._stats = {k: DomainStats(**v) for k, v in data.items()}
                logger.info(f"Loaded stats for {len(self._stats)} domains")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to load stats: {e}")
                self._stats = {}
        else:
            self._stats = {}
    
    def _load_workflows(self):
        """Load confirmed workflows."""
        if self.WORKFLOWS_DIR.exists():
            for file in self.WORKFLOWS_DIR.glob("*.json"):
                try:
                    with open(file, 'r') as f:
                        data = json.load(f)
                        workflow = SiteWorkflow(**data)
                        if workflow.success and workflow.confirmed_at:
                            self._workflows[workflow.workflow_id] = workflow
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Failed to load workflow {file}: {e}")
            logger.info(f"Loaded {len(self._workflows)} confirmed workflows")
    
    def _save_patterns(self):
        """Save patterns to disk."""
        self.DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(self.PATTERNS_FILE, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(self._patterns, f, indent=2, default=str)
    
    def _save_stats(self):
        """Save statistics to disk."""
        self.DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(self.STATS_FILE, 'w') as f:
            json.dump({k: asdict(v) for k, v in self._stats.items()}, f, indent=2, default=str)

        """Save a single workflow to disk."""
        self.WORKFLOWS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        filename = f"{workflow.domain}_{workflow.workflow_id}.json"
        path = self.WORKFLOWS_DIR / filename
        with open(path, 'w') as f:

    def save_site_workflow(
        self,
        domain: str,
        workflow: list[dict],
        form_fingerprints: list[str],
        success: bool,
        metadata: Optional[dict] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Save a workflow for a site.
        
        Args:
            domain: Site domain
            workflow: List of actions
            form_fingerprints: Hashes of form DOMs encountered
            success: Whether the workflow succeeded
            metadata: Additional info
            
        Returns:
            workflow_id
        """
        workflow_id = self._generate_workflow_id(domain)
        
        site_workflow = SiteWorkflow(
            domain=domain,
            workflow_id=workflow_id,
            actions=workflow,
            form_fingerprints=form_fingerprints,
            success=success,
            created_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
        
        if success:
            # Pending until confirmed
            self._pending_workflows[workflow_id] = site_workflow
            logger.info(f"Saved pending workflow {workflow_id} for {domain}")
        else:
            # Save failed workflow for analysis but don't use for replay
            self._save_workflow(site_workflow)
            logger.info(f"Saved failed workflow {workflow_id} for {domain} (analysis only)")
        
        return workflow_id
    
    def confirm_workflow(self, workflow_id: str) -> bool:
        """
        Confirm a pending workflow after external verification (e.g., email confirmation).
        
        Args:
            workflow_id: The workflow to confirm
            
        Returns:
            True if confirmed, False if not found
        """
        workflow = self._pending_workflows.get(workflow_id)
        if not workflow:
            logger.warning(f"Pending workflow {workflow_id} not found")
            return False
        
        workflow.confirmed_at = datetime.now().isoformat()
        self._workflows[workflow_id] = workflow
        self._save_workflow(workflow)
        
        # Update domain stats
        self._update_stats_on_success(workflow.domain)
        
        # Remove from pending
        del self._pending_workflows[workflow_id]
        
        logger.info(f"Confirmed workflow {workflow_id} for {workflow.domain}")
        return True
    
    def confirm_all_pending(self, domain: str) -> int:
        """
        Confirm all pending workflows for a domain.
        
        Returns:
            Number of workflows confirmed
        """
        count = 0
        to_confirm = [
            wid for wid, w in self._pending_workflows.items()
            if w.domain == domain
        ]
        for wid in to_confirm:
            if self.confirm_workflow(wid):
                count += 1
        return count
    
    def load_site_workflow(self, domain: str) -> Optional[SiteWorkflow]:
        """
        Load the best confirmed workflow for a domain.
        
        Priority:
        1. Most recently confirmed
        2. Highest use count (proven reliability)
        
        Returns:
            SiteWorkflow or None
        """
        domain_workflows = [
            w for w in self._workflows.values()
            if w.domain == domain and w.success and w.confirmed_at
        ]
        
        if not domain_workflows:
            return None
        
        # Sort by use count (desc), then by confirmed date (desc)
        domain_workflows.sort(key=lambda w: (w.use_count, w.confirmed_at or ""), reverse=True)
        
        best = domain_workflows[0]
        logger.info(f"Loaded workflow {best.workflow_id} for {domain} (used {best.use_count} times)")
        return best
    
    def record_workflow_usage(self, workflow_id: str):
        """Record that a workflow was used."""
        workflow = self._workflows.get(workflow_id)
        if workflow:
            workflow.use_count += 1
            workflow.last_used_at = datetime.now().isoformat()
            self._save_workflow(workflow)

    def _generate_workflow_id(self, domain: str) -> str:
        """Generate unique workflow ID."""
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        hash_input = f"{domain}_{timestamp}"
        hash_suffix = hashlib.md5(hash_input.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]
        return f"{domain}_{timestamp}_{hash_suffix}"
    
    def compute_dom_fingerprint(self, dom_snapshot: dict) -> str:
        """
        Compute fingerprint of DOM snapshot for comparison.
        
        Used to detect if we've seen similar forms before.
        """
        # Extract key features
        features = []
        
        # Form structure
        if "forms" in dom_snapshot:
            for form in dom_snapshot["forms"]:
                features.append(f"form:{form.get('fields_count', 0)}")
        
        # Input types
        if "inputs" in dom_snapshot:
            type_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
            for inp in dom_snapshot["inputs"]:
                inp_type = inp.get("type", "unknown")
                type_counts[inp_type] = type_counts.get(inp_type, 0) + 1
            for t, c in sorted(type_counts.items()):
                features.append(f"input:{t}:{c}")
        
        # Buttons
        if "buttons" in dom_snapshot:
            for btn in dom_snapshot["buttons"][:5]:  # Top 5
                text = btn.get("text", "")[:20].lower()
                features.append(f"btn:{text}")
        
        feature_str = "|".join(features)
        return hashlib.md5(feature_str.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    
    def find_similar_forms(self, fingerprint: str, threshold: float = 0.8) -> list[str]:
        """
        Find domains with similar form fingerprints.
        
        Args:
            fingerprint: DOM fingerprint to match
            threshold: Similarity threshold (0-1)
            
        Returns:
            List of domain names with similar forms
        """
        similar = []
        
        for domain, patterns in self._patterns.items():
            stored_fp = patterns.get("form_fingerprint")
            if stored_fp and self._fingerprint_similarity(fingerprint, stored_fp) >= threshold:
                similar.append(domain)
        
        return similar
    
    def _fingerprint_similarity(self, fp1: str, fp2: str) -> float:
        """
        Compute similarity between two fingerprints.
        
        Simple Jaccard similarity on character sets.
        """
        if not fp1 or not fp2:
            return 0.0
        
        set1 = set(fp1)
        set2 = set(fp2)
        
        intersection = len(set1 & set2)
        union = len(set1 | set2)
        
        return intersection / union if union > 0 else 0.0
    
    def clear_domain_data(self, domain: str):
        """Clear all stored data for a domain."""
        # Remove patterns
        if domain in self._patterns:
            del self._patterns[domain]
            self._save_patterns()
        
        # Remove stats
        if domain in self._stats:
            del self._stats[domain]
            self._save_stats()
        
        # Remove workflows
        to_remove = [wid for wid, w in self._workflows.items() if w.domain == domain]
        for wid in to_remove:
            del self._workflows[wid]
            filename = f"{domain}_{wid}.json"
            path = self.WORKFLOWS_DIR / filename
            if path.exists():
                path.unlink()
        
        # Remove pending
        to_remove = [wid for wid, w in self._pending_workflows.items() if w.domain == domain]
        for wid in to_remove:
            del self._pending_workflows[wid]
        
        logger.info(f"Cleared all data for {domain}")

    def save_site_workflow(

        domain: str,
        workflow: list[dict],

        success: bool,

    ) -> str:
        """
        Save a workflow for a site.
        
        Args:
            domain: Site domain
            workflow: List of actions
            form_fingerprints: Hashes of form DOMs encountered
            success: Whether the workflow succeeded
            metadata: Additional info
            
        Returns:
            workflow_id
        """
        workflow_id = self._generate_workflow_id(domain)
        
        site_workflow = SiteWorkflow(
            domain=domain,
            workflow_id=workflow_id,
            actions=workflow,
            form_fingerprints=form_fingerprints,
            success=success,
            created_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
        
        if success:
            # Pending until confirmed
            self._pending_workflows[workflow_id] = site_workflow
            logger.info(f"Saved pending workflow {workflow_id} for {domain}")
        else:
            # Save failed workflow for analysis but don't use for replay
            self._save_workflow(site_workflow)
            logger.info(f"Saved failed workflow {workflow_id} for {domain} (analysis only)")
        
        return workflow_id
    
    def confirm_workflow(self, workflow_id: str) -> bool:
        """
        Confirm a pending workflow after external verification (e.g., email confirmation).
        
        Args:
            workflow_id: The workflow to confirm
            
        Returns:
            True if confirmed, False if not found
        """
        workflow = self._pending_workflows.get(workflow_id)
        if not workflow:
            logger.warning(f"Pending workflow {workflow_id} not found")
            return False
        
        workflow.confirmed_at = datetime.now().isoformat()
        self._workflows[workflow_id] = workflow
        self._save_workflow(workflow)
        
        # Update domain stats
        self._update_stats_on_success(workflow.domain)
        
        # Remove from pending
        del self._pending_workflows[workflow_id]
        
        logger.info(f"Confirmed workflow {workflow_id} for {workflow.domain}")
        return True
    
    def confirm_all_pending(self, domain: str) -> int:
        """
        Confirm all pending workflows for a domain.
        
        Returns:
            Number of workflows confirmed
        """
        count = 0
        to_confirm = [
            wid for wid, w in self._pending_workflows.items()
            if w.domain == domain
        ]
        for wid in to_confirm:
            if self.confirm_workflow(wid):
                count += 1
        return count
    
    def load_site_workflow(self, domain: str) -> Optional[SiteWorkflow]:
        """
        Load the best confirmed workflow for a domain.
        
        Priority:
        1. Most recently confirmed
        2. Highest use count (proven reliability)
        
        Returns:
            SiteWorkflow or None
        """
        domain_workflows = [
            w for w in self._workflows.values()
            if w.domain == domain and w.success and w.confirmed_at
        ]
        
        if not domain_workflows:
            return None
        
        # Sort by use count (desc), then by confirmed date (desc)
        domain_workflows.sort(key=lambda w: (w.use_count, w.confirmed_at or ""), reverse=True)
        
        best = domain_workflows[0]
        logger.info(f"Loaded workflow {best.workflow_id} for {domain} (used {best.use_count} times)")
        return best

            List of domain names with similar forms

        for domain, patterns in self._patterns.items():

        set1 = set(fp1)
        set2 = set(fp2)
        
        intersection = len(set1 & set2)
        union = len(set1 | set2)
        
        return intersection / union if union > 0 else 0.0

    def _hash_dom(self, dom_snapshot: dict) -> str:

        key_data = {

    def _guess_page_type_from_dom(self, dom_snapshot: dict) -> str:
        """
        Guess page type from DOM snapshot.
        
        Returns:
            page_type string
        """
        # Check for error indicators
        if not dom_snapshot:
            return 'error'
        
        # Check for login requirement
        if dom_snapshot.get('has_login_form'):
            return 'login_required'
        
        # Check for captcha
        if dom_snapshot.get('has_captcha'):
            return 'error'  # Can't proceed with captcha
        
        # Count form inputs
        inputs = dom_snapshot.get('inputs', [])
        forms = dom_snapshot.get('forms', [])
        
        # If multiple inputs and forms → likely application form
        if len(inputs) >= 3 and forms:
            # Check for wizard indicators
            if dom_snapshot.get('has_progress_indicator'):
                return 'form_wizard'
            return 'form_single'
        
        # Check for job listing indicators
        buttons = dom_snapshot.get('buttons', [])
        links = dom_snapshot.get('links', [])
        
        has_apply = any(
            'apply' in (b.get('text', '')).lower()
            for b in buttons + links
        )
        
        if has_apply and len(inputs) < 3:
            return 'job_listing'
        
        # Check for confirmation indicators
        page_title = dom_snapshot.get('page_title', '').lower()
        if any(word in page_title for word in ['thank', 'confirm', 'success', 'submitted']):
            return 'confirmation'
        
        return 'unknown'

        """Extract preview of visible form fields."""
        preview = []
        for inp in dom_snapshot.get('inputs', [])[:10]:  # First 10 fields
            preview.append({
                'label': inp.get('label', ''),
                'type_guess': inp.get('type', 'text'),
                'required': inp.get('required', False),
            })
        return preview

        """
        Perform vision analysis using Kimi 2.5.
        
        Args:
            screenshot_path: Path to screenshot
            
        Returns:
            Vision analysis result dict or None
        """
        if not self.kimi_vision:
            return None
        
        try:
            # Read screenshot
            with open(screenshot_path, 'rb') as f:
                image_bytes = f.read()
            
            # Call Kimi Vision
            response = await self.kimi_vision.generate_with_image(
                prompt=RECON_VISION_PROMPT,
                image_bytes=image_bytes,
            )
            
            # Parse JSON response
            # Handle potential markdown code blocks
            response = response.strip()
            if response.startswith('```'):
                # Remove markdown code blocks
                response = re.sub(r'^```(?:json)?\n?', '', response)
                response = re.sub(r'\n?```$', '', response)
            
            result = json.loads(response)
            logger.debug(f"Vision analysis: {result}")
            return result
            
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logger.warning(f"Vision response not valid JSON: {e}")
            return None
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Vision analysis failed: {e}")
            return None

        if vision_result:
            vision_page_type = vision_result.get('page_type', '').lower()
            if vision_page_type in ('job_listing', 'login_required', 'form_single', 'form_wizard', 'confirmation', 'error'):
                page_type = vision_page_type
            
            apply_info = vision_result.get('apply_button', {})

            language = vision_result.get('language', language)

            blocked_reason = "captcha"
        
        return SiteSchema(

        try:
            # Read screenshot

            # Call Kimi Vision

            if response.startswith('```'):

        """Categorize the question for better context."""
        question_lower = question.lower()

        return None
    
    async def _call_client(self, client: Any, prompt: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Call an LLM client with the prompt."""
        # Check if client has async generate method
        if hasattr(client, "generate"):
            if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(client.generate):
                return await client.generate(prompt)
            else:
                return client.generate(prompt)
        
        # Check for chat method
        if hasattr(client, "chat"):
            if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(client.chat):
                return await client.chat(prompt)
            else:
                return client.chat(prompt)
        
        # Check for __call__ method
        if callable(client):
            return client(prompt)
        
        raise ValueError(f"Client {type(client)} has no compatible method")
    
    def _estimate_confidence(self, answer: str, question: str) -> float:
        """Estimate confidence of the answer."""
        # Simple heuristic-based confidence estimation
        
        # Check if answer is too short
        if len(answer.strip()) < 3:
            return 0.2
        
        # Check if answer is too long for expected format
        if len(answer) > 500:
            return 0.5
        
        # Check for hedging language
        hedging = ["maybe", "perhaps", "might", "possibly", "i think", "probably"]
        answer_lower = answer.lower()
        for word in hedging:
            if word in answer_lower:
                return 0.6
        
        # Check for refusals
        refusals = ["cannot", "can't", "unable", "don't know", "not sure"]
        for word in refusals:
            if word in answer_lower:
                return 0.3
        
        # Check for good length
        if 10 <= len(answer) <= 200:
            return 0.85
        
        # Default
        return 0.7

        question: str,
        context: Optional[dict],
        options: Optional[list[str]],
        exclude: str,
    ) -> list[AnswerVariant]:
        """Generate variant answers."""
        variants = []
        
        count = min(self._max_variants - 1, len(self._available_clients) - 1)
        if count <= 0:
            return variants
        
        try:
            all_variants = await self.ask_variants(question, context, options, count + 1)
            for v in all_variants:
                if v.answer != exclude and v.answer not in [x.answer for x in variants]:
                    variants.append(v)
                    if len(variants) >= count:
                        break
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Variant generation failed: {e}")
        
        return variants
    
    def _make_cache_key(
        self,
        question: str,
        context: Optional[dict],
        options: Optional[list[str]],
    ) -> str:
        """Create a cache key for the question."""
        import hashlib
        
        key_parts = [question.lower().strip()]
        
        if context:
            company = context.get("company", "")
            title = context.get("title", "")
            key_parts.extend([company, title])
        
        if options:
            key_parts.extend(options)
        
        key_str = "|".join(key_parts)
        return hashlib.md5(key_str.encode()).hexdigest()

        """Call an LLM client with the prompt."""
        # Check if client has async generate method
        if hasattr(client, "generate"):
            if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(client.generate):
                return await client.generate(prompt)
            else:
                return client.generate(prompt)
        
        # Check for chat method
        if hasattr(client, "chat"):
            if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(client.chat):
                return await client.chat(prompt)
            else:
                return client.chat(prompt)
        
        # Check for __call__ method
        if callable(client):
            return client(prompt)
        
        raise ValueError(f"Client {type(client)} has no compatible method")
    
    def _estimate_confidence(self, answer: str, question: str) -> float:
        """Estimate confidence of the answer."""
        # Simple heuristic-based confidence estimation
        
        # Check if answer is too short
        if len(answer.strip()) < 3:
            return 0.2
        
        # Check if answer is too long for expected format
        if len(answer) > 500:
            return 0.5
        
        # Check for hedging language
        hedging = ["maybe", "perhaps", "might", "possibly", "i think", "probably"]
        answer_lower = answer.lower()
        for word in hedging:
            if word in answer_lower:
                return 0.6
        
        # Check for refusals
        refusals = ["cannot", "can't", "unable", "don't know", "not sure"]
        for word in refusals:
            if word in answer_lower:
                return 0.3
        
        # Check for good length
        if 10 <= len(answer) <= 200:
            return 0.85
        
        # Default

          "text": "class QueueManager:
    """
    Job queue manager for processing job applications.
    
    Routes jobs to appropriate appliers:
    1. Known ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.) → dedicated applier
    2. Unknown/Custom sites → BlindApplier
    3. Account-required sites → mark as external
    
    Features:
    - Concurrent processing with rate limiting
    - Retry logic for failed applications
    - Progress tracking and statistics
    - Support for headed/headless browser modes
    """
    
    # Known ATS platforms with dedicated appliers
    KNOWN_ATS = {
        "greenhouse": "greenhouse",
        "lever": "lever",
        "workday": "workday",
        "ashby": "ashby",
        "bamboohr": "bamboohr",
        "smartrecruiters": "smartrecruiters",
        "indeed": "indeed",
        "linkedin": "linkedin",
    }
    
    # ATS platforms that should use BlindApplier
    BLIND_ATS = {"unknown", "icims", "taleo", "brassring", "jobvite", "custom"}
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        profile: dict,
        db: Optional[Database] = None,
        max_concurrent: int = 3,
        headed: bool = False,
        retry_limit: int = 2,
        on_result: Optional[Callable[[Job, ApplicationResult], None]] = None,
    ):
        """
        Initialize QueueManager.
        
        Args:
            profile: User profile data for applications
            db: Database instance for job storage
            max_concurrent: Maximum concurrent applications
            headed: Run browser in headed mode (visible)
            retry_limit: Maximum retries per job
            on_result: Callback for application results
        """
        self.profile = profile
        self.db = db or Database()
        self.max_concurrent = max_concurrent
        self.headed = headed
        self.retry_limit = retry_limit
        self.on_result = on_result
        
        self._running = False
        self._queue: asyncio.Queue[Job] = asyncio.Queue()
        self._workers: list[asyncio.Task] = []
        self._processed_count = 0
        self._error_count = 0
        
        # Import ATSDetector
        try:
            from src.applier.ats_detector import ATSDetector
            self.ats_detector = ATSDetector
        except ImportError:
            # Use inline ATSDetector if not available
            from src.applier.blind.recon_agent import ATSDetector as InlineATSDetector
            self.ats_detector = InlineATSDetector
    
    async def start(self):
        """Start the queue processor."""
        if self._running:
            logger.warning("Queue already running")
            return
        
        self._running = True
        
        # Load pending jobs into queue
        pending = await self.db.get_pending_jobs()
        for job in pending:
            await self._queue.put(job)
        
        logger.info(f"🚀 Queue started with {len(pending)} pending jobs")
        
        # Start worker tasks
        for i in range(self.max_concurrent):
            worker = asyncio.create_task(self._worker(i))
            self._workers.append(worker)
    
    async def stop(self):
        """Stop the queue processor."""
        self._running = False
        
        # Cancel workers
        for worker in self._workers:
            worker.cancel()
        
        # Wait for workers to finish
        if self._workers:
            await asyncio.gather(*self._workers, return_exceptions=True)
        
        self._workers.clear()
        logger.info("🛑 Queue stopped")
    
    async def add_job(self, job: Job) -> bool:
        """Add a job to the queue."""
        added = await self.db.add_job(job)
        if added:
            await self._queue.put(job)
            logger.info(f"➕ Added job: {job.id} - {job.title} at {job.company}")
        return added
    
    async def add_jobs(self, jobs: list[Job]) -> int:
        """Add multiple jobs to the queue."""
        count = 0
        for job in jobs:
            if await self.add_job(job):
                count += 1
        return count
    
    async def _worker(self, worker_id: int):
        """Worker coroutine for processing jobs."""
        logger.info(f"👷 Worker {worker_id} started")
        
        while self._running:
            try:
                # Get job from queue with timeout
                try:
                    job = await asyncio.wait_for(self._queue.get(), timeout=1.0)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    continue
                
                # Process job
                await self._process_job(job, worker_id)
                
                # Mark task done
                self._queue.task_done()
                
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                logger.info(f"👷 Worker {worker_id} cancelled")
                break
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"👷 Worker {worker_id} error: {e}")
                self._error_count += 1
    
    async def _process_job(self, job: Job, worker_id: int):
        """Process a single job application."""
        logger.info(f"👷 Worker {worker_id}: Processing {job.id} - {job.title}")
        
        # Update status
        job.status = JobStatus.PROCESSING
        job.attempts += 1
        await self.db.update_status(job.id, "processing")
        
        try:
            # Detect ATS
            ats_type = self.ats_detector.detect(job.apply_url or job.url)
            logger.info(f"🔍 Detected ATS: {ats_type} for {job.url}")
            
            # Route to appropriate applier
            if ats_type in self.KNOWN_ATS:
                result = await self._apply_known_ats(job, ats_type)
            elif ats_type in self.BLIND_ATS or ats_type == "unknown":
                result = await self._apply_blind(job)
            else:
                # Unknown ATS - try BlindApplier
                result = await self._apply_blind(job)
            
            # Update job status based on result
            await self._update_job_status(job, result)
            
            # Call result callback
            if self.on_result:
                self.on_result(job, result)
            
            self._processed_count += 1
            logger.info(f"✅ Job {job.id} completed: {result.value}")
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Job {job.id} failed: {e}")
            await self._handle_apply_error(job, e)
    
    async def _apply_known_ats(self, job: Job, ats_type: str) -> ApplicationResult:
        """Apply using a known ATS applier."""
        logger.info(f"🎯 Using {ats_type} applier for {job.url}")
        
        # Try to import the specific applier
        applier_module = f"src.applier.{ats_type}_applier"
        try:
            module = __import__(applier_module, fromlist=[""])
            applier_class = getattr(module, f"{ats_type.capitalize()}Applier", None)
            
            if applier_class:
                applier = applier_class(headed=self.headed)
                result = await applier.apply(job, self.profile)
                
                if result.get("success"):
                    return ApplicationResult.SUCCESS
                elif result.get("error") == "already_applied":
                    return ApplicationResult.ALREADY_APPLIED
                elif result.get("error") == "captcha":
                    return ApplicationResult.CAPTCHA
                else:
                    return ApplicationResult.FORM_ERROR
            else:
                # Fall back to BlindApplier
                logger.warning(f"No {ats_type} applier found, using BlindApplier")
                return await self._apply_blind(job)
                
        except ImportError:
            logger.warning(f"Could not import {ats_type} applier, using BlindApplier")
            return await self._apply_blind(job)
    
    async def _apply_blind(self, job: Job) -> ApplicationResult:
        """Apply via BlindApplier for custom/unknown sites."""
        logger.info(f"🔮 BlindApplier: trying {job.url!r}")
        
        try:
            from src.applier.blind import BlindApplier
            
            applier = BlindApplier(
                profile=self.profile,
                headed=self.headed,
            )
            result = await applier.apply(job)
            
            if result.success:
                return ApplicationResult.SUCCESS
            elif result.error == "account_required":
                return ApplicationResult.EXTERNAL
            elif result.error == "captcha":
                return ApplicationResult.CAPTCHA
            elif result.error == "already_applied":
                return ApplicationResult.ALREADY_APPLIED
            else:
                return ApplicationResult.FORM_ERROR
                
        except ImportError as e:
            logger.error(f"Could not import BlindApplier: {e}")
            return ApplicationResult.NOT_SUPPORTED
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"BlindApplier error: {e}")
            return await self._handle_apply_error(job, e)
    
    async def _update_job_status(self, job: Job, result: ApplicationResult):
        """Update job status based on application result."""
        status_map = {
            ApplicationResult.SUCCESS: "applied",
            ApplicationResult.EXTERNAL: "external",
            ApplicationResult.CAPTCHA: "error",

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Optional


class PageType(Enum):
    """Types of pages detected during reconnaissance."""
    JOB_LISTING = "job_listing"
    LOGIN_REQUIRED = "login_required"
    FORM_SINGLE = "form_single"
    FORM_WIZARD = "form_wizard"
    CONFIRMATION = "confirmation"
    ERROR = "error"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"


class OutcomeType(Enum):
    """Possible outcomes after form submission."""
    SUCCESS = "success"
    ERROR = "error"
    LOADING = "loading"
    SAME_PAGE = "same_page"
    REDIRECT = "redirect"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"
    
    # Additional types for detector
    TIMEOUT = "timeout"
    CAPTCHA = "captcha"
    ACCOUNT_REQUIRED = "account_required"


@dataclass
class BoundingBox:
    """Bounding box coordinates for an element."""
    x: int
    y: int
    width: int
    height: int
    
    def center(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        """Get center coordinates."""
        return (self.x + self.width // 2, self.y + self.height // 2)


@dataclass
class ApplyButtonInfo:
    """Information about an Apply button."""
    visible: bool = False
    text: str = ""
    location: str = ""  # Description like "top-right", "center"
    selector: Optional[str] = None
    bbox: Optional[BoundingBox] = None
    
    @property
    def found(self) -> bool:
        """Alias for visible for test compatibility."""
        return self.visible


@dataclass
class FormFieldPreview:
    """Preview of a form field detected during recon."""
    label: str
    type_guess: str  # text, email, phone, select, file, etc.
    required: bool = False
    selector: Optional[str] = None  # CSS selector if found


@dataclass
class SiteSchema:
    """
    Result of site reconnaissance.
    
    Describes the structure and characteristics of a custom career site.
    """
    url: str
    domain: str
    page_type: str  # PageType enum value
    requires_account: bool = False
    has_apply_button: bool = False
    apply_button_hint: str = ""  # Description for LLM
    apply_button_info: Optional[ApplyButtonInfo] = None
    estimated_steps: int = 1
    language: str = "en"
    detected_ats: str = "unknown"  # If resembles known ATS
    form_fields_preview: list[FormFieldPreview] = field(default_factory=list)
    blocked_reason: Optional[str] = None  # captcha, geo-block, 404
    screenshot_path: str = ""
    raw_dom_hash: str = ""
    confidence: float = 0.0
    
    # Additional DOM analysis results
    has_login_form: bool = False
    forms_count: int = 0
    inputs_count: int = 0
    buttons_count: int = 0
    page_title: str = ""
    meta_description: str = ""
    
    # Additional fields for recon_agent compatibility
    dom_snapshot: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now().isoformat())


@dataclass
class StepSnapshot:
    """Snapshot of a wizard step for tracking and comparison."""
    step_number: int = 0
    url: str = ""
    dom_hash: str = ""
    screenshot_hash: str = ""
    timestamp: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    fields_detected: int = 0
    fields_filled: int = 0
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    @property
    def fields_count(self) -> int:
        """Alias for fields_detected for test compatibility."""
        return self.fields_detected


@dataclass
class StepDiff:
    """Difference between two consecutive steps."""
    added_fields: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    removed_fields: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    url_changed: bool = False
    dom_changed: bool = False
    progress_indicator_changed: bool = False
    new_step_detected: bool = False


@dataclass
class WizardResult:
    """Result of wizard execution."""
    success: bool
    steps_completed: int = 0
    steps_total: int = 0  # Estimated
    filled_fields: int = 0
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    fingerprints: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # Form fingerprints
    step_snapshots: list[StepSnapshot] = field(default_factory=list)
    final_url: str = ""
    reference_id: Optional[str] = None
    confidence: float = 0.0
    patterns: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # For learning


@dataclass
class OutcomeResult:
    """Result of outcome detection."""
    outcome: Any  # OutcomeType enum value or str - use OutcomeType when possible
    success: bool = False  # Computed in __post_init__ if not explicitly set
    confidence: float = 0.0
    message: str = ""
    error: Optional[str] = None
    reference_id: Optional[str] = None
    final_url: str = ""
    screenshot_path: str = ""
    success_signals: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failure_signals: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    error_details: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Compute success from outcome if not explicitly set."""
        if isinstance(self.outcome, str):
            self.success = self.outcome.lower() == "success"
        elif isinstance(self.outcome, OutcomeType):
            self.success = self.outcome == OutcomeType.SUCCESS
        # If success was explicitly set to True, keep it
        # (this allows overriding the computed value)


@dataclass
class ApplyResult:

            )
        return self._client
    
    async def generate_with_image(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        image_bytes: bytes,
        image_format: str = "png",
        system_prompt: str | None = None,
        json_mode: bool = True,
    ) -> VisionResponse:
        """
        Send image + text prompt to Kimi 2.5 vision.
        
        Args:
            prompt: Text prompt/question about the image
            image_bytes: Raw image bytes (PNG, JPEG, etc.)
            image_format: Image format (png, jpeg, webp)
            system_prompt: Optional system prompt for context
            json_mode: If True, request JSON response
        
        Returns:
            VisionResponse with text and optionally parsed JSON
        """
        client = await self._get_client()
        
        # Encode image to base64
        image_b64 = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode()
        media_type = f"image/{image_format.lower()}"
        
        # Build message content
        content: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
            {
                "type": "image_url",
                "image_url": {
                    "url": f"data:{media_type};base64,{image_b64}"
                }
            },
            {
                "type": "text",
                "text": prompt
            }
        ]
        
        # Build messages
        messages = []
        if system_prompt:
            messages.append({
                "role": "system",
                "content": system_prompt
            })
        messages.append({
            "role": "user",
            "content": content
        })
        
        # Add JSON instruction if needed
        if json_mode:
            messages.append({
                "role": "system",
                "content": "IMPORTANT: You must respond with valid JSON only. No markdown, no explanation, just the JSON object."
            })
        
        try:
            response = await client.chat.completions.create(
                model=self.MODEL,
                messages=messages,
                max_tokens=self.max_tokens,
                temperature=self.temperature,
            )
            
            text = response.choices[0].message.content or ""
            
            # Parse JSON if requested
            parsed_json = None
            confidence = 0.0

                parsed_json = self._extract_json(text)
                if parsed_json and "confidence" in parsed_json:

                parsed_json=parsed_json,
                confidence=confidence,

    async def detect_outcome(
        self,

    ) -> dict:

        Returns:

        """
        prompt = """Look at this screenshot after clicking "Submit" on a job application form.

Determine the outcome:
1. SUCCESS — confirmation page, "thank you" message, reference number
2. ERROR — validation error, red error messages, "required field" warnings
3. LOADING — spinner, "processing..." message
4. SAME_PAGE — nothing changed, still on the same form

Return JSON only:

    "outcome": "SUCCESS|ERROR|LOADING|SAME_PAGE|REDIRECT",
    "confidence": 0.95,

    "detected_elements": ["thank you message", "confirmation number"]

    def _extract_json(self, text: str) -> dict | None:
        """Extract JSON from response text (handles markdown code blocks)."""
        import json
        import re
        
        # Try direct parse
        text = text.strip()
        
        # Remove markdown code blocks if present
        if "```json" in text:
            match = re.search(r"```json\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```", text)
            if match:
                text = match.group(1)
        elif "```" in text:
            match = re.search(r"```\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```", text)
            if match:
                text = match.group(1)
        
        try:
            return json.loads(text)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            # Try to find JSON object in text
            match = re.search(r"\{[\s\S]*\}", text)
            if match:
                try:
                    return json.loads(match.group())
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    pass
            return None

class BlindApplier:
    """

    Flow:

    2. ReconAgent → Site analysis
    3. PageNavigator → Navigate to form
    4. WizardEngine → Handle multi-step forms
    5. OutcomeDetector → Detect result

    7. SitePatternStore → Store patterns
    
    Usage:
        applier = BlindApplier(profile=my_profile)
        result = await applier.apply(job_dict)
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        profile: dict,
        config: Optional[BlindApplierConfig] = None,
        pattern_store: Optional[SitePatternStore] = None,
        notifier: Optional[Any] = None,
    ):
        """
        Initialize BlindApplier.
        
        Args:
            profile: User profile data for form filling
            config: Configuration options
            pattern_store: SitePatternStore instance (created if None)
            notifier: Optional notifier for Telegram/email notifications
        """
        self.profile = profile
        self.config = config or BlindApplierConfig()
        self.pattern_store = pattern_store or SitePatternStore()
        self.notifier = notifier
        
        # Initialize components (lazy - created on demand)
        self._recon: Optional[ReconAgent] = None
        self._navigator: Optional[PageNavigator] = None
        self._form_filler: Optional[VisionFormFiller] = None
        self._wizard: Optional[WizardEngine] = None
        self._outcome_detector: Optional[OutcomeDetector] = None
        
        # State tracking
        self._vision_calls = 0
        self._current_recorder: Optional[ReplayRecorder] = None
    
    @property

        """Lazy-initialize ReconAgent."""
        if self._recon is None:
            self._recon = ReconAgent()
        return self._recon
    
    @property
    def navigator(self) -> PageNavigator:
        """Lazy-initialize PageNavigator."""
        if self._navigator is None:
            self._navigator = PageNavigator()
        return self._navigator
    
    @property
    def form_filler(self) -> VisionFormFiller:
        """Lazy-initialize VisionFormFiller."""

        return self._form_filler

        if self._wizard is None:
            self._wizard = WizardEngine(
                max_steps=self.config.max_steps,
                step_timeout=self.config.step_timeout,
            )
        return self._wizard
